extraction.Name: Lucy Provost
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want the patent to her 480 acre allotment at the time she received it; but it was mailed to her through the Pine Ridge Agency, and, as she understood it would be taxed against her at any rate, she accepted it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: mortgaged the place to Ed Ross, of Gordon, Nebraska, for $1600.00, in 1921, Ross foreclosed on the allotment, paying the taxes
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to Ed Ross of Gordon, Nebraska for $1600.00; Ross foreclosed in 1921
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: got behind in taxes, and, in 1920, she mortgaged the place to Ed Ross, of Gordon, Nebraska, for $1600.00, in 1921, Ross foreclosed on the allotment, paying the taxes
extraction.Occupation/Income: husband's only income is derived by working at common labor, which is his only income
extraction.NOTES: Document No. 45; mentally incompetent; left side is paralyzed and had three ribs removed, cannot do her house work; has five small children; husband's health is only fair and supports the family; has never received any aid from the County, State or United States Government; affidavit subscribed and sworn before Notary Public on 24th of November, 1928
